precision: Calibrated approximate partial sums; binary endpoint does not make cell currents identical; 24-bit output containers do not imply exact integer arithmetic.

mapping.transaction_pattern: d=0..127, s=0..3; c=4*h+s, r=(c+d) mod128, h=0..31; all eight planes
mapping.verify_rule: In each plane, 16 ADC lanes a=0..15; pass k=0,1 selects c=8*a+4*k+s and the selected diagonal row; repeat fullF_A/reset/re-read for each pass; no 32-sample hold.
mapping.read_resource: 128x128 binary arrays per plane; read selects eight input rows and 16 output columns, eight planes in parallel; program diagonal gate decode and column switches are mode-isolated from voltage MAC frontend.
mapping.write_resource: One global domain with 32 current IDACs, each selects one of four columns in one active plane; 8:1 plane routing, current-compliance supply, mode switches, diagonal gate decoder, 256-bit transaction buffer, 32 data/mask latches; 16 ADC per plane reused for verify.
mapping.arbitrary_sparse_update: The tabulated service is an aligned 32-weight diagonal transaction. Full matrix reload aggregates 512 such transactions. Sparse or contiguous writes with fewer useful selected weights require a smaller BR and cannot inherit full tau.
mapping.mode_access_selection: Per-cell mode gate mux selects compute input-WL gate or diagonal gate, with two routing networks, level shifting and unselected-plane isolation; not simply co-wiring original gate decoders. Read F and write g include selected mux/parasitic settling; circuit timing remains a reference condition.
mapping.voltage_to_partial_sum: 128 parallel per-ADC 9-level calibrated decoders with column-dependent thresholds/LUT. First TD combines voltage decode and8-plane weighted sum, second TD accumulates input bit. Raw SAR code is not a popcount; intra-class conductance variation remains approximate error.

program.pulse_sequence: Per physical batch: select/configure one TD; driver establish g; RESET all32 once; quench/rebias g; masked SET target1 once; return to read bias g; verify all32 in two new reads; commit transaction only after all8 planes pass.
program.verify_adc_timing: Main binary verify uses the same IM/clamp/column voltage path with single-cell diagonal selection: full F_A already covers q=0 and q=1 endpoint levels at fixed bias/column load, followed by shared TA and16parallel two-class comparisons in one TD. No assumption that8cell signal always larger. Per-mode thresholds calibrate inactive-branch leakage/offset; same access-gate voltage and clamp compliance required. Each pass repeats full F_A; no hold.
program.acceptance: Two calibrated endpoint classes: HRS below lower threshold, SET above upper threshold, with disjoint band and rail check; source |GRESET|<5 and GSET>50 ADC-count unit-cell distributions motivate separation only. New local thresholds are calibrated in the chosen SAR/voltage frontend, not copied as literal shared-ADC counts. No analog target-tuning or per-weight error guarantee.
program.normal_service_condition: One full RESET/SET schedule on characterized working cells reaches the two endpoint classes. Final verify is real time and rejects failures; a failed transaction produces no successful BR. No empirical batch yield, retry distribution, or worst-case bound is claimed; retry count is not silently folded into tau.
program.timing_ambiguity: PCM01 p7 SET 'width of250ns with trailing edge of50ns' does not disambiguate inclusion. Main conservatively uses300ns; total250ns variant recorded as sensitivity.
program.driver_bridge: 10/20/50ns each for current-source/switch settle, post-RESET quench/rebias, and post-SET return are explicit engineering budgets around ns-to-hundreds-ns PCM waveforms, not measured recovery or microsecond HV overhead. Main verify repeats the same F_A bias/front settle; optional weak-signal comparison alone repeats256ns precharge.
driver_transition_endpoints: Mode/IDAC route reaches intendedRESET programming current before pulse
AfterRESET completes: quench at zero current and change toSETbias before pulse
After complete300nsSET including50nstail: isolateIDAC and restore lowreadbias, no duplicate trailingedge
program.verify_weak_signal_comparison: Single alternative retains PCM01-inspired256ns precharge+512ns low-current read frontend, then replacement SAR+TD; source CCO not added. This is a deliberately conservative analog-style organization, not compulsory binary timing.

maintenance.scope: Immediately usable endpoint state with calibrated read path; no periodic drift-compensation interval is inferred. Long-term recalibration must later consume service time. Endurance remains a feasibility constraint, separate from instantaneous tau.

exceptions.reason: PCM03 p1/Fig11.3.2 voltage-summing topology activates8WL; pureSLC retains this representative grouping, not a PCM material limit.
exceptions.both_services: 16 row groups multiply read rounds; programming uses separate diagonal selection and explicit batch list.

exceptions.reason: Read front F=10/20/50ns includes shared TI; API receives tm=F−TI. PCM03 full access3.25–15.9ns is an order anchor, never an isolated cell delay or extra macro cycle.
exceptions.both_services: Binary verify front repeats F_A per16cells, sharing the sameIM/clamp/column path and coveredq=0/1 endpoint level range;768ns analog weak-signal frontend only an explicit comparison. No free analog hold.

exceptions.both_services: BR32Byte/8physical batches;16verify passes. The single contrast changes binary frontF_A to768ns weak-signal front; streaming/read and all32IDAC resources unchanged.

evidence.use: Driver/diagonal/pulse/weak-read anchors;30 is not mandatory binary retry count.

evidence.locator: MVM characterization; weight programming; power measurements; TableI
evidence.use: State separation supports binary choice, does not prove new mapping batch yield. Original4PCM unit-cell/ADC counts are not scalar PCM universal conductance.
8-row voltage topology and pureSLC margin cross-check. Access includes native frontend/sensing/logic and cannot be appended to all shared stages.
Endpoint variability weaker than intermediate state; actual512 resource topology is an alternative not automatically installed. CLT uses FPGA; no FPGA waiting put into local service.
Independent Ge-richGST pulse scale; neither voltage nor1000 pulses imported into main schedule.

scenario_interpretation.main_range: conditional paired short/reference/long engineering scenarios, not a physical uncertainty envelope
scenario_interpretation.linked: Each shared profile TD and its control/boundary terms must move together; media timing choices need not physically co-vary with the shared profile.
scenario_interpretation.maintenance_scope: No periodic maintenance in the modeled local service window; raw occupancy equals effective interval for the stated accepted service scenario.
